text: Members may access staffed facilities during the published hours for each location.
Premium members may bring one guest per visit. Basic members need a paid guest pass.
Basic membership is $89 per month. It includes gym-floor access at one home location, standard group classes, locker-room use, and booking access up to 5 days in advance.
Premium membership is $129 per month. It includes all Basic benefits, access to all locations, premium classes, one guest per visit, and booking access up to 10 days in advance.
Student membership is $69 per month with valid student identification. It includes off-peak gym access, standard group classes, and booking access up to 3 days in advance.
Family membership starts at $219 per month for two adults at the same address. Additional family members can be added for $45 per person per month.
New memberships require a completed sign-up form, identity verification, a payment method on file, agreement to club rules, and a minimum age of 16. Members aged 16 or 17 need guardian consent.
Memberships renew monthly on the renewal date. Failed payments may place the account into past-due status, which can pause booking privileges until the balance is cleared.
Members may request one freeze per calendar year for 2 to 8 weeks. Cancellation requires 7 days notice before the next renewal date; prepaid or promotional fees may be non-refundable.
Customers should confirm their preferred location, class access needs, guest needs, renewal date, cancellation window, and any medical clearance requirements before buying a membership.
Class bookings cancelled less than four hours before start time may incur a late-cancel fee.
When a booked member cancels, the first waitlisted member is promoted automatically and notified.
Staff and automated assistants must not provide medical, injury, rehabilitation, or clinical nutrition advice.
Closed-toe shoes are required on the gym floor. Studio classes may set additional safety requirements.
